jobs.title: Project Manager (B2B Social Creative)
jobs.location: Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
jobs.description:
Grounded in a talent-centric mindset, Maker Lab is a marketing agency designed to build decentralised technology-led agency teams, rooted in collaboration with clients from the ground up. Maker Lab's cross-functional teams of multidisciplinary specialists are embedded into client teams across digital marketing competencies — from measurement & analytics to content production.

Project Manager

As the Project Manager you will lead the delivery of a new creative production team making bold, social-first content for business audiences across APAC. Working with a team of designers and art directors, you'll turn briefs into a steady flow of thumb-stopping content (short-form video series, creator collaborations, carousels, event and festive campaigns) and make sure every piece lands on time, on brief and on brand.

Role:

Own end-to-end delivery of social-first creative projects, from briefing and planning through production, approvals and handover for publishing.
Manage recurring video series and creator collaborations, planning around seasonal moments such as festive periods and major industry events.
Act as the main point of contact between the client's regional and country marketing teams and the creative team, translating business objectives into clear creative briefs.
Build and manage production schedules across multiple concurrent projects, identifying risks and dependencies early and keeping work moving.
Manage intake and prioritisation of incoming requests, balancing always-on content with campaign and event peaks.
Coordinate reviews and approvals with stakeholders, including legal and brand checks, across markets.
Manage creators, production houses, and freelancers: scope, contracts, timelines, and budgets.
Track and report on project status, resourcing and budget, and continuously improve workflows and processes for the team.
Support content localisation and adaptation for different markets across the region.

You:
BA/BS degree or equivalent experience
5+ years of project management experience in a creative, social or digital agency, or an in-house content team.
Proven experience delivering high-volume social content (short-form video, static, carousels) for brands, ideally B2B or technology.
Strong understanding of social platforms (Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok) and what makes content work on each.
Highly organised, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities at once.
Confident managing senior stakeholders and creative teams, including remote teams across countries.
Experience with project management tools such as Asana, Monday.com, Jira or Workfront.
Experience working with creators, influencers or production partners is a strong advantage.
Exceptional verbal and written English communication and presentation skills

Look out for future roles! By submitting your application, you consent to the collection, use and disclosure of your data by the Maker Lab team for the purposes of your application. jobs.description:
About The Opportunity

Netrix Global is looking for a Project Manager

to join our Services Transition Team within Netrix Managed Services. The Managed Services Project Manager (MS PM) is responsible for managing the onboard or startup of Netrix managed services to new and existing clients in accordance with Statements of Work. Onboard scenarios range from multiple-service tower onboards for new customers, to new services for existing customers and service changes for existing customers. The MS PM may also manage standalone technology projects for existing Managed Services customers and offboarding of services at end of contract.

Service onboarding and Managed Services projects are performed using a cross-functional team approach led by the Project Manager and staffed with technical resources from Service Delivery Teams. In addition to Delivery Team resources, the PM interacts with other internal teams such as Sales and Finance and works closely with clients during projects and service onboards.

How You Will Make An Impact

Role

As a member of our Team, you will help drive the timely and effective turn up of Managed Services and associated revenue for new and existing clients. Serving as the “first face” of Netrix to our customers, you play a critical role towards successful long term customer relationships:

Provide a positive and consistent customer experience as a face of Netrix
Ensure consistent and effective quality of work through application of industry standard Project Management and Netrix processes and procedures
Enable successful downstream management of services through effective onboards
Ensure timely and accurate revenue for services provided to customers
Ensure new service onboarding and changes positively impact customer and delivery experiences
Help identify additional sales opportunities through customer and Netrix interactions
Manage customer expectations and communications from initial kick-off call, status calls and other communication vehicles
Manage adherence to schedule and scope

What You Will Bring To The Table

Minimum 3 years' Project Management/Coordination experience with IT projects and/or leading, coordinating or managing customer or service transitions
Base level experience and understanding of Managed Service Provider (MSP) technologies and services such as Cloud Infrastructure Management, Managed Security Services and IT Service Desks
Ability to adapt and learn from new assignments and situations
Ability to lead cross-functional teams working with customers
Ability to handle multiple assignments in a fast-paced environment
Experience/knowledge of project management techniques and tools

About Us

At Netrix Global our values are the philosophies and principles that we live by. They support our vision, help us achieve our goals and commit us to a common purpose.

We Own Outcomes, Win Together, Make An Impact, Enjoy The Journey, and Respect All!

Netrix Global is a mission-driven organization with the goal of providing the people, processes, and technology needed to run and scale modern, data-driven businesses that are always on and always secure. Our breadth of capabilities allows us to provide holistic offerings that solve even today's most complex business challenges, delivering to you an integrated, optimized, and future-proof solution.

We work with clients of all sizes and specialize in solutions for healthcare, manufacturing, government, education, financial services, and legal industries. Netrix is consistently ranked in the CRN VAR500, detailing the country's top system integrators.

At Netrix, we're driven to solve business problems with innovative technology solutions. We focus on end-users and are committed to client satisfaction.

What You Can Expect From Us

We offer a competitive compensation package, comprehensive group benefits to meet the needs of you and your family, flexibility, and time off when you need it, and a casual work environment. The role can be remote/home office, with some travel required.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Our hiring, promotion and compensation processes are based on merit, skills, and qualifications, to ensure a fair and unbiased approach for our candidates and employees. As part of this commitment, we will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. If you need a reasonable accommodation, please let us know by contacting NetrixHR@Netrixglobal. To learn more about Netrix Global please go to www.netrixglobal.com

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
About The Role

Cyber Advisors delivers a wide range of IT and Cyber Security project services for clients, and successful delivery requires more than technical execution. It requires strong coordination across schedules, documentation, communication, task ownership, and follow-through to keep projects organized and moving forward.

The Project Coordinator works alongside the technical teams, vendors, and client stakeholders to support the planning and execution of project work. This role helps ensure every moving part is tracked, every task has an owner, project information stays current, and risks or open items are surfaced before they impact delivery. If you thrive on process, communication, organization, and keeping project work on track, apply today!

This role is targeted for local candidates in the following markets: Minneapolis/St. Paul, MN, Fargo, ND, Schaumburg, IL, Salt Lake City, UT, Wilmington, NC, Richmond, VA, Rocky Mount, NC and, Raleigh, NC. All other candidates will automatically be excluded **

About The Role

Successful delivery at Cyber Advisors takes more than technical execution. The Project Manager owns client engagements from handoff through closure, serving as the central point of contact for clients, engineers, testers, assessors, vendors and internal stakeholders. You will plan the work, keep every task owned and moving, protect scope and budget, and communicate clearly that no one is surprised.

Our PMO operates as an enterprise-wide function rather than a set of PMs tied to a single service silo. You will manage a portfolio of concurrent projects across our service lines and grow into managing work from start to finish across all of Cyber Advisors' offerings. Our delivery model is a hybrid approach: a structured, waterfall-style foundation for scope, timeline and milestones, paired with Agile practices that let projects adapt as new information emerges.

The Work You Will Manage

Microsoft cloud and modern workplace projects, such as Microsoft 365 and tenant migrations, Intune and Autopilot deployments, mobile device management, Microsoft 365 Business Premium implementations, identity migrations (for example, Okta to Entra ID) and endpoint management

Networking and infrastructure projects, including firewall, switching and wireless deployments, Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) and Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) implementations

Offensive Security engagements, including external, internal, application, wireless and cloud penetration testing, and Red Team and Purple Team exercises

Risk Management and compliance engagements, including gap assessments, audit preparation and audits against frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO, HIPAA, PCI, NIST and CIS

Managed Services onboarding and offboarding, transitioning new clients into steady-state support with our Service Desk, operations and Customer Success teams
What You'll Do
Project Initiation and Planning
Review newly assigned projects and statements of work (SOWs), validate scope against the sold opportunity, and resolve discrepancies with Account Executives and Solutions Architects before work begins
Send client welcome communications within defined service levels and introduce yourself as the client's primary point of contact
Lead internal review meetings with sales and technical teams, then lead client kickoff meetings, distributing minutes, action items and next steps within 24 hours
Build project schedules, work plans, milestones and communication cadences; confirm prerequisites, access, licensing, hardware and client responsibilities
Coordinate technical resources based on skill set, certification requirements, availability and workload, and schedule engineer and tester time
For security engagements, confirm rules of engagement, testing windows, target scope, exclusions and compliance drivers; for compliance engagements, coordinate evidence requests, interviews and secure document exchange

Execution, Monitoring and Control

Run recurring client check-ins and internal status meetings, keeping action items, decisions and owners clearly documented
Track deliverables, dependencies, risks, issues and action items across your portfolio, and escalate blockers before they affect timelines
Monitor estimated versus consumed hours, remaining budget and percent complete on fixed-fee and time-and-materials projects, and flag potential overruns early
Identify out-of-scope requests and manage the change order process with clients, sales and delivery teams
Keep project status, work plans, time entries, notes and documentation current and accurate in ConnectWise and our resource-scheduling tools
Provide clear, timely written status updates to clients, technical leads and leadership

Closure and Handoff

Coordinate final deliverables, including reports, readouts, configuration documentation and handover materials, and facilitate internal quality review where required
Obtain client acceptance, coordinate handoff to Managed Services or the client's IT team, and notify Finance for invoicing
Close projects and tickets in a timely manner, archive project materials, send client satisfaction surveys and capture lessons learned
Continuous Improvement
Contribute to PMO standards, SOPs, templates, email communications and reporting
Support PMO metrics such as on-time delivery, budget accuracy, change order capture, closure timeliness, data quality and client satisfaction
Mentor Project Coordinators and share best practices across the PMO

Required

What You Bring

3 to 5 years of project management experience delivering client-facing projects in IT services, managed services, cybersecurity or a similar technology environment
Demonstrated ability to manage many concurrent projects in a high-volume environment while maintaining accuracy, follow-through and a high-touch client experience
Solid understanding of the project lifecycle, including scope, schedule, resource planning, budget and hours tracking, risk, issue and change management
Technical fluency in IT infrastructure, Microsoft cloud, networking or security to coordinate work intelligently, while relying on technical specialists for technical decisions
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including client emails, meeting recaps, status reports and executive summaries that need minimal editing
Confidence facilitating meetings with clients, engineers, vendors and leadership, and balancing client urgency against scope, capacity and budget
Proficiency with Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, Excel and PowerPoint

Preferred

PMP, CAPM or a comparable certification
Experience in an MSP, MSSP, technology consulting or IT professional services organization
Experience with ConnectWise PSA or a comparable PSA, ticketing or project management platform
Familiarity with penetration testing, compliance audits or Managed Services onboarding engagements
Experience with Power BI or similar reporting tools
Working Conditions
This is a hybrid role; regular in-office presence is required at our Cyber Advisors office
Ability to lift and move IT equipment up to 50 lbs

Why Cyber Advisors

A team that takes project management seriously and is actively investing in its PMO
Exposure to a broad portfolio of IT and cybersecurity work, with room to grow your career
Hybrid flexibility, a collaborative environment and a team that has your back
Direct visibility into how your work shapes client experience and team efficiency

What We Offer

Competitive compensation and performance-based incentives
Vacation and PTO
Employer-paid health and dental insurance for Cyber Advisors employees
401(k) with employer matching
Professional development opportunities, including certifications and ongoing training

jobs.title: AI Program Manager
jobs.description:
About Melior

Melior is an AI transformation firm built for the way business leaders actually want to adopt AI - strategically, practically, and with measurable impact. We serve as the AI Transformation Partner for mid-market companies, guiding them through the full adoption curve across two integrated pillars:

Workforce Adoption. We help companies build an AI-first culture - setting AI policy and tool selection, running enterprise-wide training and upskilling, and driving the change management required to turn tool access into real, lasting behavior change.
Custom AI Workflows. We engineer purpose-built AI workflows and agents for our clients' highest-value problems - from discovery and roadmapping through custom development that integrates directly into their existing tech stack.

What sets us apart for other players in our space is the combination of deep operational experience and real technical depth to build impactful AI solutions.

Melior is led by a team of proven operators and technologists who have built, scaled, and exited businesses across consulting, marketing services, and technology.

Ryan Markman, CEO - Former Bain consultant, experienced C-suite operator with a previous business exit, and an AI product leader.
Ken Baker, COO - Two-time CEO with 15+ years leading large professional services businesses, including a marketing services firm he co-founded, scaled and exited.
Adrien Delessert, CTO - Veteran CTO and software engineer across multiple venture-backed companies, with deep expertise in ML and AI engineering.

Joining Melior means working directly alongside a leadership team that has managed complex organizations, navigated real change management challenges, and built technical systems at scale. Now we're applying all of it to the most consequential technology shift in business today.

The Role

As An AI Program Manager, You'll Work Directly With Our Executive Team To Lead Client Engagements End-to-end, Owning The Strategy, Adoption, And Measurable Impact Of Melior's Partnership With Each Client. You'll Collaborate With Clients At Every Level Of Their Organization—from Senior Executives To Frontline Teams. Your Day-to-day Will Involve

Sitting down (virtually) with clients to deeply understand their current work processes, identify pain points, and brainstorm ways AI could help.
Owning the executive relationship, running QBRs, reporting EBITDA and ROI impact, shaping AI policy and tool selection, and serving as the strategic partner to our client's executive teams on their overall AI transformation roadmap.
Owning client retention and renewal, keeping clients engaged, demonstrating ongoing value, and ensuring the partnership continues to grow.
Scoping and prioritizing AI workflow and agent opportunities, then partnering with our engineering team to shape the builds and keep each one tied to a measurable business outcome.
Working alongside client teams to test, refine, and measure these solutions to ensure they genuinely improve their work.
Leading AI training and upskilling programs, from company-wide AI kickoffs and foundational syllabi to department-level sessions, 1-1 coaching with leadership, and ongoing office hours.
Driving change management and adoption, co-leading exec-sponsored AI kickoffs, building reinforcement strategies, and making sure new ways of working actually stick across the organization.
Documenting what you learn into straightforward playbooks and resources that we can reuse across future projects.
Helping us evolve our offerings and processes - as an early team member, your ideas and experiences will directly shape how we grow and the solutions we deliver.

This role is built for someone who is genuinely excited about AI technology, energized by client relationships, and gets real satisfaction from earning an executive's trust, driving organizational change, and seeing a client's business perform better because of the partnership. If you want hands-on experience applying one of the most exciting technologies in business today at scale, across industries; there aren't many better places to do it.

This is a hybrid role in Philadelphia, but we are open to remote work for the right candidate.

Who We're Looking For

We think you'd be great for this role if you:

Have spent 4+ years in client-facing roles — consulting, account management, agency services, or solutions — where you owned relationships, managed deliverables, and were accountable to demanding clients. Experience in client services or agency organizations is a strong plus.
Are confident and thoughtful in conversations at all levels of an organization, able to quickly build trust and understand people's genuine needs. You've run exec-level meetings and navigated multi-stakeholder relationships before.
Are genuinely excited about generative AI and have been actively finding ways to use AI to improve your work, whether through side projects, small automations, or prototypes at work
Have a structured way of thinking about problems: you're great at framing messy questions, estimating the potential impact of solutions, and organizing your work clearly.
Have a track record of retaining and growing client relationships. You understand that the real work starts after the contract is signed, and you take personal ownership over whether clients are getting value, staying engaged, and renewing.
Are organized and proactive—you're good at managing your own projects, deadlines, and client communications in a fast-paced, small-team environment.
Have led training, enablement, or change management programs before. You know what it takes to shift how an organization actually works, not just what's on the slide deck.

Bonus points (but not required!) if you've coded your own apps via Claude Code or Codex, experimented with API calls and Python scripting, or built workflows in no-code platforms like Zapier, n8n, or Airtable.

Why Join Melior?

Real Impact: You'll have a direct influence on the trajectory of our company. Your work and ideas will shape how Melior operates and grows. You'll guide executive leadership teams on their journey through the largest shift in the last 20 years of business.
Accelerate AI Expertise: For our money, there's no better way to accelerate your practical AI knowledge than to join Melior. You'll go beyond theory to build real-world solutions clients use immediately.
Growth & Equity: Our business has more than doubled in the first six months of 2025, and we want you to share in our growth. As an early team member, you'll have equity in the company and a clear pathway to grow into a leadership role
Variety and Depth: You'll explore different industries and tackle a wide range of interesting, practical problems. One week might involve content workflows at a marketing agency, another could be streamlining sales processes at a SaaS firm.

If you're excited about building practical AI solutions that genuinely help people do better work, we'd love to hear from you.

The target salary for this role is $90,000 - $130,000 per year.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
About FX Digital

FX Digital is a specialist Connected TV agency, providing a wide range of services, including Product Strategy, Design, Engineering, and Test Automation. We partner with global streaming brands such as Discovery+, BritBox, ATP Media, ITV, and Dyn.

Role Summary

Owns end-to-end delivery on complex or multi-workstream projects: planning, RAID, budgets, forecasting, margin and change control, anticipating risk before it's raised. Leads cross-functional project teams, including TAs, Product Managers, Designers, Engineers and QAs. A trusted senior contact who builds strong client relationships, leads difficult conversations unsupported and keeps senior stakeholders informed proactively.

Brings solutions rather than problems, introduces new practices and tools, and formally mentors and/or manages junior colleagues, building a psychologically safe, accountable team environment on their projects.

What You'll Do

Delivery Performance

Planning - build integrated plans across workstreams, manage the cross-workstream critical path, and model scenarios to support decisions.
Risk & RAID - anticipate systemic risk across workstreams and drive mitigation across teams; keep RAID decision-ready, so it's used as the source of truth in client and leadership reviews.
Change control - run change control across your projects, taking every CR through approval.
Agile & continuous delivery - tailor the agile approach across workstreams; use delivery metrics to forecast and spot risk early.
Releases - work with Engineering to move projects towards continuous delivery (feature flags, automated release gates, frequent small releases), balanced against client approval and CTV platform certification.
Product Owner role - act as Product Owner on smaller, less complex projects with no dedicated Product Manager, owning the backlog, prioritisation and acceptance criteria; judge when a dedicated Product Manager is needed instead.
Delivery KPIs - keep schedule and cost variance, RAG-red weeks and project lifecycle sign-offs on track against department targets across complex portfolios.

Financial Performance

Budgets, forecasting & margin - own budgets, forecasting and margin across larger or concurrent projects, protecting margin proactively.
Cadence - monitor weekly, re-forecast at least fortnightly, and flag any margin variance across all your projects.
CR estimates - estimate change requests with the team before any commitment is made to the client.
Time & overtime - track time accurately and follow the overtime request process where applicable.
Forecast accuracy - keep forecast accuracy at or above the department KPIs.

Client Experience

Client relationship management - act as the trusted senior contact for client stakeholders, building trust-based relationships and leading difficult conversations and negotiations unsupported.
Status communication - keep client and internal senior stakeholders informed with proactive, consistent status updates across workstreams.
Issue & defect communication - communicate issues, defects and bugs proactively, factually and promptly, including unwelcome news to senior stakeholders, always with options.
Technical translation - frame technical trade-offs for senior or executive stakeholders, and challenge technical recommendations that don't serve the client outcome.
Client feedback - seek regular client feedback across your projects and act on it, keeping client satisfaction at or above the department target and adopting a ‘yes, but' approach where required.

Operational Excellence

Tools & reporting - champion best practice across the team's tools.
Innovation & continuous improvement - introduce new practices and tools on your projects, measure the results and share them; drive process improvement beyond your own projects.
AI & new tools - lead adoption of FX-approved AI and automation tools across your workstreams, within FX tooling and client data policies.

Leadership & Collaboration

Team leadership & mentoring - formally mentor and/or manage junior colleagues and set the team culture on your projects, building a psychologically safe, accountable environment.
Stakeholder management - resolve competing priorities between senior client and internal stakeholders without escalation (e.g. launch date vs stability, extra scope vs budget).
Account growth - actively shape and pitch expansion opportunities, starting from what the client is trying to achieve.
Impact assessments - own impact assessments for new or expanded scope, including delivery approach, risk and resourcing, and present them to the Commercial Team and client where applicable.

What You Bring

Judgement under pressure - consistently acts as a Project Leader, not a coordinator: anticipates problems before they land, brings solutions and a recommendation, makes the call on difficult trade-offs, and stays composed under pressure.
Ownership - anticipates slippage; holds team and self to the same standard.
Strategic thinking - shapes delivery approach and planning decisions; anticipates future account needs.
Communication - reads senior and executive audiences and adapts the message in the moment.
Candour - delivers unwelcome news to senior stakeholders, with options.
Innovation mindset - actively looks for new practices and technology that improve delivery, and tests them rather than waiting for others to.
Learning - shares what they learn across the department.
Collaboration - creates an environment where mistakes are raised without blame.
Influence - influences without authority across disciplines and senior stakeholders.

Experience

5-8 years leading complex or concurrent delivery, with demonstrated mentoring and/or management of other PMs, or equivalent demonstrated capability.

Desirable

Experience in a digital agency, ideally delivering apps or streaming products for multiple clients.
Exposure to OTT/CTV, streaming, or broader digital product delivery.
Experience building or improving a delivery process or templates that the department went on to adopt.
Experience leading adoption of AI or new tooling within a delivery team.

Why work at FX?

To recognise everyone's incredible contribution to the success of the business, we offer an annual profit share
Personal development is hugely important, so we invest time for you to up-skill, learn and grow
Personal pension with salary sacrifice, and medical insurance
Early finish Fridays in the summer
Flexible working - with the option to work 2 days a week from home
We appreciate that the world has changed and so we also offer a flexi start time between 8am and 10am
To ensure that our remote workers don't miss out on the office experience, we have invested in technology that allows us to run company events in a hybrid way
Every month you have the option of a one-on-one Sanctus mental health coaching session, a great opportunity to get quality mental health support at work
Take part in regular company-wide and team-specific socials (both in-person and remote)
We take great pride in our culture of acceptance, diversity and inclusion
Complete regular surveys to provide anonymous feedback on the business, leadership team and your role to ensure that we are doing everything we can to keep improving and making FX a great place to work
Join us at our monthly Show and Tell, where team members update us on what they've been working on
Get nominated for the monthly FX Factor by your peers and get recognised for your contribution to the business
We are invested in your growth and so we run regular appraisals, to ensure you are receiving constant feedback and working towards goals for growth
We support our team to get involved in conferences, events and trade shows at home and abroad
Work with epic and prestigious global brands in the media, sport and entertainment space, from Discovery to BBC and ATP Media

If you're passionate about this role and believe you can add value, we encourage you to apply, even if your background doesn't match the job description exactly.

This is a full-time role based out of our office in Poblenou, Barcelona. We can only consider applicants who are able to work 3 days per week from the office.

Under the general direction of the Assistant Dean of Graduate Academic Affairs, the incumbent provides high-level professional expertise, complex analysis, and project management leadership to the Division of Graduate Education and Postdoctoral Affairs (GEPA) in support of graduate degree programs, campus reviews, and other strategic initiatives. Advanced experience and knowledge with educational initiatives, new program development, and academic policies and procedures in a university environment.
Advanced project management experience. Includes demonstrated ability to set project objectives, determine and address potential barriers; identify required resources, identify process steps and milestones; and adjust action plans to achieve desired outcomes.
Demonstrated experience and ability to conduct research and analysis to inform decisions or recommend improvements to programs, policies, or processes; analyze and anticipate needs and problems; problem-solve independently and appropriately; make decisions; plan and implement complex projects and events. Advanced analytical / problem-solving skills.
Strong demonstrated experience managing resources, budgets, revenue projections, and accurately estimating program costs. Experience budgeting expenses; projecting revenue streams; developing financial models.
Demonstrated experience and ability to develop and maintain effective, productive, and cooperative working, reporting, and professional relationships with employees at all levels of the organization, working collaboratively with individuals and groups to incorporate their ideas and adapt to their needs.
Thorough knowledge of organizational or initiative processes, protocols and procedures. Proven ability to guide the efforts of cross-organizational work groups, and to build consensus among a broad spectrum of diverse constituencies and at varying organizational levels.
Advanced knowledge of applicable policy analysis techniques. Proven ability to make recommendations and take actions based on understanding and judgment of all factors involved and based on independent interpretation and application of various disciplines involved.

Demonstrated high-level skill in assessing needs and developing strategies to support diversity and inclusion.

Skill in negotiating and exchanging ideas with others and to arrive jointly at decisions, conclusions or solutions. Ability to clearly articulate goals, strategies and direction. Excellent team building and group facilitation skills, applied to diverse work groups and difficult individuals.
Demonstrated ability to learn quickly and independently understand, analyze, and interpret complex written material, financial data, and computer-generated information and effectively communicate results of analyses to senior campus management and others.
Ability to multitask with demanding timeframes. Demonstrated ability to work independently and under pressure, to manage multiple concurrent tasks and responsibilities, and to deal with changing priorities, while maintaining personal effectiveness.

With over 200 professional experts across the globe, we service some of the worlds' most successful Fortune 500 and Fortune 1000 companies.

About The Role

Anovia is looking for a hands-on information security and compliance professional with practical experience working with ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, or similar security and compliance programs.

The successful candidate will have experience helping an organization prepare for and work through an audit or certification process, including developing and maintaining policies and controls, supporting evidence collection, coordinating activities and meetings, tracking actions, and working with internal and external auditors.

This is also a build and delivery role. Anovia has a number of technical and operational initiatives that require more structure, planning, coordination, and follow-through. The successful candidate will be comfortable taking an initiative that is not yet well defined, establishing a practical plan, coordinating the people involved, and driving the work through to completion. Examples could include implementing a new security tool, improving security monitoring or vulnerability management, or helping establish a NOC/SOC capability.

Responsibilities

Maintain and continue to develop Anovia's ISO/IEC 27001 Information Security Management System (ISMS), including policies, procedures, controls, risks, objectives, evidence, and ongoing improvement activities.
Support ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, and other security and compliance initiatives as they are introduced and developed.
Coordinate internal and external audit activities, including preparing evidence, scheduling and facilitating meetings, maintaining action items, and ensuring audit findings and resulting actions are addressed.
Maintain the information asset inventory and data classification program, including assigning and tracking ownership.

Monitor and improve security tooling and processes, including Microsoft 365 security capabilities, Microsoft Defender, Intune, Entra ID, security monitoring, endpoint protection, and vulnerability management.

Develop, maintain, and support adoption of information security policies, standards, and operating procedures.
Coordinate security awareness training and phishing simulation programs.
Support security incident response activities, including detection, containment, investigation, root-cause analysis, and post-incident reporting.
Support business continuity and disaster recovery activities, including maintenance of recovery requirements, testing, and related evidence.
Lead or coordinate technical and operational initiatives from initial scope through implementation, establishing plans, identifying dependencies and owners, coordinating stakeholders, tracking risks and issues, and driving work to completion.
Serve as a primary point of contact for internal and external auditors and coordinate responses with relevant business and technical stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

4+ years of progressively responsible experience in information security, IT compliance, GRC, security operations, or a related field.
Practical experience working with ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2, or a comparable security and compliance framework. Experience should include meaningful participation in an audit or certification process and familiarity with activities such as policy development, control implementation, evidence collection, audit preparation, management meetings, action tracking, and remediation.
Experience with GRC processes and tools, including risk and control management, evidence collection, compliance tracking, audit preparation, and remediation or corrective-action management.
Working experience with the Microsoft 365 security environment, including familiarity with Microsoft Defender, Intune, Entra ID, and related security and compliance capabilities.
Demonstrated ability to take an ambiguous technical or operational initiative and bring structure to it, including defining scope, developing a practical plan, coordinating stakeholders, managing dependencies and issues, and driving the work through to completion.

Experience with GRC platforms such as Secureframe, Vanta, Drata, or OneTrust.
Experience with SIEM, EDR/endpoint protection, vulnerability scanners, or related security tooling beyond the Microsoft 365 environment.

Exposure to GRC automation tools (e.g., Vanta, Drata, ServiceNow IRM, or LogicGate).

Review programme requirements and recommend improvements in processes, staffing, infrastructure, and resources.

Regular blood transfusions
Chelation adherence and monitoring
Laboratory investigations
Complication screening
Patient counselling
Follow-up and appointment adherence
Referral and coordination with treating hospitals/doctors

Coordinate with medical and nursing teams to address operational issues affecting patient care.
Ensure that patient concerns and grievances are appropriately addressed and escalated when required.

Conduct regular team meetings and review programme performance.
Set individual and team objectives in consultation with reporting managers.
Monitor employee performance, attendance, productivity, and work discipline.
Identify training and capacity-building requirements.
Mentor team members and encourage professional development.
Address performance or behavioural concerns in coordination with HR and senior management.
Ensure adequate manpower planning and support recruitment requirements.

Track patient enrolment, retention, transfusion adherence, follow-up, investigations, counselling, and other programme indicators.
Prepare regular programme dashboards and performance reports.
Analyse trends, identify gaps, and recommend corrective actions.
Conduct periodic programme reviews with the team.
Establish systems for tracking action points and ensuring timely closure.
Evaluate programme effectiveness and recommend evidence-based improvements.

Ensure accurate, complete, and timely entry of programme and patient data.
Maintain appropriate programme records and documentation.
Ensure confidentiality and responsible handling of patient information.
Coordinate with MIS/data teams to ensure accuracy of reports.
Conduct periodic data verification and identify discrepancies.
Develop and maintain appropriate trackers and dashboards for programme monitoring.
Ensure documentation is audit-ready and readily available when required.

F. Financial & Resource Management
Prepare programme budgets in coordination with the Finance and Senior Management teams.
Monitor programme expenditure against approved budgets.
Ensure optimum utilisation of programme resources.
Review financial requirements and provide timely inputs for budget planning.
Monitor programme-related procurement and resource requirements.
Ensure compliance with financial policies and approval processes.
Identify opportunities for cost optimisation without compromising patient care or programme quality.

Prepare timely programme updates, reports, presentations, and impact reports for donors and management.

Maintain professional and effective relationships with key stakeholders.
Represent Sankalp in relevant meetings, workshops, conferences, and programme reviews when delegated.

Conduct periodic internal programme reviews.
Identify operational, patient-care, data, financial, and compliance risks.

Promote a culture of quality, accountability, patient safety, and continuous improvement.

Escalate patient-care or clinical concerns to the appropriate medical authority.

Develop and implement SOPs, workflows, checklists, and monitoring systems where required.

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment

Ability to meet deadlines

The Team

Our Supply Chain & Network Operations offering advises, implements, and operates transformational solutions that bring world class supply network capabilities.

or, 15 years minimum + bachelor's degree in related field

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager – Water Technology & Innovation
jobs.description:
Would you like to turn real-world water challenges into new innovation projects that can be tested, implemented and scaled?
Water Valley Denmark is looking for a technically minded Project Manager with experience from the water sector who can understand complex challenges, develop new project ideas and bring the right companies, utilities and knowledge partners together to create solutions.
At Water Valley Denmark, we connect companies, utilities, municipalities and knowledge institutions to turn real water challenges into innovation projects. We identify needs, find the right technologies and expertise, build partnerships and develop projects that can create real value and be tested in practice.

Your role

As a Technical Project Manager, you will play a central role in developing and leading innovation projects through our Project Engine.
You will work across the entire project process – from identifying challenges and opportunities and developing project ideas to building partnerships, securing funding, testing, implementation and scaling.

Your key responsibilities

Lead innovation projects
from the initial idea through project development, funding, testing and implementation.
Identify water-related challenges and opportunities together with companies, utilities, municipalities, knowledge institutions and other stakeholders, and turn them into concrete project ideas.
Develop project concepts, objectives, business cases and KPIs.
Build partnerships and consortia by connecting challenges with the right technologies, expertise and knowledge partners.
Identify and pursue relevant national and European funding opportunities and contribute to funding applications.
Coordinate testing and demonstration of technologies in relevant real-world environments.
Follow project progress, milestones and KPIs, document results and identify opportunities for implementation and scaling.
Bring different companies, organisations and areas of expertise together around shared water challenges.
Develop relationships with national and international partners and identify new opportunities for collaboration.

Who are you?

You have a technical or scientific degree and professional experience from the water sector
, combined with experience in project management, technical consulting, process optimisation, technology development or a related field.
You could be an engineer, environmental technologist, technical consultant or another technically oriented professional with relevant experience from the water sector.

We are looking for someone who:

Has experience leading projects and driving them from idea to tangible results.
Has a good understanding of the water sector and the challenges facing water utilities, companies or other water-related organisations.
Can understand complex technical challenges and ask the right questions.
Can identify challenges and opportunities and turn them into new project ideas.
Is curious about technology and able to see opportunities across different industries and areas of expertise.
Can connect different companies, disciplines and organisations around a shared water challenge.
Is structured and able to manage timelines, milestones, deliverables and stakeholders.
Is motivated by innovation, new technologies and sustainable water solutions.
Communicates confidently in both Danish and English, verbally and in writing. Fluency in both languages is required.

Experience that is an advantage – but not a requirement

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be an advantage:
Smart water management, data, IoT and digitalisation
Drinking water, water distribution and water infrastructure
Cybersecurity, critical infrastructure and resilience
Climate adaptation and water resilience
Digital twins, modelling and data-driven optimisation
Cooling systems, industrial cooling or data centre infrastructure
Water, energy and cooling

Experience with technology testing, demonstration projects, funding applications, consortium building or commercialisation is also an advantage.
You do not need experience across all these areas. We are looking for someone with a strong technical foundation and relevant water-sector experience who is curious, collaborative and able to connect different technologies, organisations and challenges into new project opportunities.

What we offer

At Water Valley Denmark, you will have the opportunity to work on some of the most important challenges facing the water sector and help bring new technologies closer to real-world application.
You will join an ambitious innovation environment with a broad network of Danish and international companies, utilities and knowledge institutions.
We offer:
A central role in developing and leading tangible innovation projects.
Close collaboration with leading companies and stakeholders across the water sector.
The opportunity to work with emerging technologies and real-world testing and demonstration projects.
A varied role combining technical project management, project development, business development and partnerships.
The opportunity to help bring technologies from identified challenges to testing, implementation, scaling and export.
Flexibility to work from home 1–2 days per week.

Ready to help shape the future of water technology?

If you are motivated by solving real-world water challenges, leading projects, developing new project ideas and bringing different partners together to create tangible results, we would love to hear from you.
Please submit your application and CV through LinkedIn. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Ida Infront söker en projektledare för att leda utveckling och införande av lösningar till våra kunder. Vi erbjuder dig stora möjligheter att vara med och påverka, ett utmanande och utvecklande jobb, i ett väletablerat och stabilt företag.

Vi arbetar med digitalisering av samhället, så om du vill ha en central roll i verksamheten och designa stora samhällsviktiga system kan det här vara en möjlighet för dig! Vår produktfamilj iipax möjliggör bland annat ett passfritt Europa, e-deklarationer och effektiva dna-analyser.

Det finns många fördelar med att arbeta hos oss. Här blir du en del av ett framgångsrikt IT-produktföretag med platt organisation och stabil kundbas. Vi är verkligen stolta över den samhällsnytta våra system bidrar till. Vi är också ett värderingsstyrt företag med stark laganda, en familjär atmosfär, och vi satsar på att ge våra medarbetare goda möjligheter till kompetensutveckling.

Du får en god introduktion av dina kollegor och via Ida University, som är ett skräddarsytt introduktionsprogram för att komma in i arbetet och fortsätta utvecklas med oss.

Du är placerad på något av våra kontor i centrala Linköping eller centrala Stockholm. Det funkar även fint att jobba på distans från ditt hemmakontor eller någon annanstans i Sverige där du trivs att jobba.

Rollbeskrivning

Som projektledare inom affärsområdet Case Solutions är du en viktig spelare för utvecklingen och leveransen av våra kundlösningar och är delaktig i att vidareutveckla våra erbjudanden.

Tillsammans med utvecklingsteam, lösningsarkitekter och produktledning leder och samordnar du arbetet och ser till att projektet drivs framåt på ett strukturerat sätt. Arbetet innebär också nära kundkontakter. Det är du som håller ihop projektet och säkerställer att kundens behov omhändertas och att leveransen sker enligt överenskomna mål och förutsättningar.

Du kommer att få en viktig roll i våra kundprojekt och i hur vår produkt används och införs hos våra kunder. I rollen ingår också att hjälpa våra kunder att planera och genomföra förändringar och införanden. För att säkerställa detta medverkar du i offertarbete, projekt och förvaltning samt i stor utsträckning i dialogen med kundens organisation.

Som projektledare arbetar du med följande:
• Planerar, leder och följer upp projekt från start till leverans
• Ansvarar för projektets planering, framdrift, ekonomi och rapportering
• Samordnar utvecklingsteam, lösningsarkitekter, kund och andra intressenter
• Säkerställer att kundens behov, krav och prioriteringar hanteras inom projektet
• Identifierar och hanterar risker, beroenden och förändringar i projektet
• Medverkar i offertarbete och planering av nya kundprojekt
• Driver och leder projektmöten, styrgrupper och andra forum tillsammans med kunden
• Samverkar med produktchef och lösningsarkitekter för att planera och prioritera utveckling och leveranser
• Tar ett aktivt ansvar för att se synergier mellan kunder för att öka möjligheten till återanvändning
• Tar ett aktivt ansvar för att arbeta som förändringsledare i kundprojekten

Din profil

Du har en högskoleutbildning inom IT eller motsvarande kunskaper.

Vi tror att du har gedigen erfarenhet av att leda IT-projekt, gärna i större organisationer och inom offentlig sektor. Du triggar på att ha kontakt med kund och har intresse för verksamhet, teknik och utveckling av IT-system. Du har en god förståelse för IT-arkitektur, integrationer och systemutveckling och är van vid att arbeta tillsammans med utvecklingsteam.

Erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt och projektledning inom systemutveckling är meriterande.

Du har svenskt medborgarskap, vilket krävs för att arbeta i våra säkerhetsklassade projekt.

Personliga förmågor

Som projektledare har du en god kommunikativ förmåga. En stor del av arbetet handlar om att leda, koordinera och skapa tydlighet mellan utvecklingsteamet, lösningsarkitekter och inte minst kundens organisation.

Du känner dig trygg i att fatta beslut och driva arbetet framåt även när alla förutsättningar inte är givna. Du trivs med att arbeta självständigt samt att koordinera och samordna. Du är strukturerad, lösningsorienterad och har förmågan att skapa förtroende både internt och hos kund.

Ansökan

Ida Infront anser att mångfald berikar verksamheten och välkomnar sökande med olika bakgrund, kön, erfarenhet samt personliga egenskaper. Urvalet sker löpande, så vänta inte med din ansökan.

Vid frågor om jobbet eller oss, kontakta Value Stream Manager Adam Eriksson.
Mail: adam.eriksson@idainfront.se

Vi har valt rekryteringsupplägg och undanber oss kontakt från säljare, annonsörer och rekryterare.

jobs.title: Product Manager & Business Analyst
jobs.description:
About Interpay

Interpay builds the retail payment software that banks and merchants across Saudi Arabia depend on: POS and SoftPOS acceptance, e-commerce gateways, payment switching and merchant services. Our products handle cardholder data under SAMA regulation and PCI security standards, and they run around the clock.

The role

This is a deliberately combined role. You'll own what Interpay builds and why, based on customer needs, market demand and regulatory obligation, and do the business analysis that turns those decisions into specifications engineering can act on. The role also covers finance and credit products. You'll report directly to the CTO. Fluent Arabic is mandatory, as you'll work directly with Saudi banks, merchants and regulators.

What you'll do

Product management
Product definition:
define features from customer requirements, market demand, competitive positioning and regulatory obligation
Roadmap:
build and communicate the roadmap, balancing customer commitments, technical debt, compliance deadlines and strategy
Prioritisation:
own the backlog, and make and defend priority calls when demand exceeds capacity
Voice of the customer:
work directly with banks, merchants, payment service providers and sales to understand needs in the Saudi market
Market analysis:
track competitors, market trends and emerging payment technologies
Lifecycle:
manage features from concept to launch, iteration and retirement, with clear success measures
Go-to-market:
support positioning, collateral, pricing input, release communications and customer enablement

Business analysis
Elicit and document requirements with business users, project managers and development teams
Analyse processes and workflows, and recommend practical improvements
Write functional specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria
Run gap analyses, feasibility studies and impact assessments
Facilitate workshops and stakeholder interviews, and give clear status updates
Produce process models, data flows and wireframes that make requirements concrete

Payments domain
Know Interpay's POS, SoftPOS, e-commerce gateway and switching products in depth
Turn Visa, Mastercard and mada mandates into product requirements and delivery plans
Interpret SAMA requirements, including data residency obligations
Build PCI DSS and PCI Secure SLC implications into feature design from the start
Specify product behaviour across authorisation, reversal, settlement, reconciliation and disputes

Finance and credit
Support lending, instalment and buy-now-pay-later propositions
Apply credit assessment, scoring and rating concepts to merchant and consumer features
Contribute to merchant onboarding, underwriting, KYC and AML requirements
Use interchange, merchant discount rate, settlement cycles and fee structures to shape product economics
Partner with finance and risk so product decisions are commercially sound and well controlled

Delivery
Stay with the development teams through delivery to resolve questions
Take part in backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives
Define test scenarios and acceptance criteria with QA, and take part in UAT
Support training, release notes and user documentation so new features are adopted

What you'll bring

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Finance or a related field; a Master's is a plus
5+ years in business analysis, product management or a combined role, with delivered product outcomes
Fluent Arabic (mandatory)
, with excellent written and verbal communication, plus professional working proficiency in English
Payments, fintech or banking experience, with an understanding of how payment products work commercially and technically
Requirements elicitation, process modelling, data analysis and user stories
Prioritising competing demands and defending those calls to senior stakeholders
Strong stakeholder management with technical and non-technical audiences
Agile delivery experience
Jira, Azure DevOps or Confluence
Willing and eligible to work on-site in Riyadh

Nice to have

POS, SoftPOS, e-commerce gateway or payment switching products
Lending, instalment, buy-now-pay-later, credit scoring or credit rating products
SAMA regulation, or comparable financial regulation in another market
mada, Visa or Mastercard scheme rules and mandates
Merchant onboarding, underwriting, KYC and AML
PCI DSS and its implications for product design
SQL or analytics tools for independent data investigation
Figma or similar wireframing and prototyping tools
CBAP, CCBA, PMI-PBA, Certified Scrum Product Owner or SAFe Product Owner / Product Manager
Saudi or wider GCC market experience

How we work

Commercial judgement:
you weigh value, effort and risk and reach a decision you can defend
Analytical rigour:
you turn an ambiguous business problem into precise, testable requirements
Influence:
you build agreement across engineering, commercial and regulatory stakeholders without formal authority
Clear writing:
your specifications leave little room for misinterpretation
Domain curiosity:
you go deep on payments, finance and credit
Ownership:
you carry a feature from idea through launch and stay accountable for the outcome

Where and when

Full-time, on-site at our Riyadh office, with regular meetings and workshops. Travel to customer, partner or regulator meetings within the Kingdom may be required.

The role covers day-to-day vulnerability assessment operations across the Bank’s infrastructure, including scan management, finding validation, configuration reviews, risk classification, reporting and remediation tracking. The engineer will also coordinate with ISECURION’s specialist teams for web, mobile, API and source code security assessments.

Key Responsibilities

Infrastructure Vulnerability Assessment & Management

• Perform authenticated and unauthenticated vulnerability assessments of approximately 450 IT assets across the Data Centre (DC) and Disaster Recovery (DR) environments.
• Configure, schedule and manage scans using Nessus, Qualys, Tenable or equivalent tools, including policies and plugin updates.
• Run asset discovery scans, validate findings and eliminate false positives.
• Classify vulnerabilities (Critical, High, Medium, Low) using CVSS, asset criticality and business impact.
• Track new, recurring and resolved findings through periodic scans and remediation follow-up.

Configuration Assessment & Hardening Review

• Review configurations of Windows, Linux, Solaris and IBM AIX systems; Oracle, MS SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL and MariaDB databases; and network devices (routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, WAF) against CIS Benchmarks, NIST guidelines and OEM best practices.

• Prepare hardening gap reports with practical recommendations.

Application, API & Source Code Security Coordination

• Coordinate web (Internet Banking, corporate website), mobile (Android/iOS) and API security assessments aligned to OWASP Top 10, supporting automated scans and basic validation.
• Coordinate SAST and SCA activities for in-house applications and track findings.
• Liaise with ISECURION’s specialist teams for advanced manual testing and consolidate their findings.

Phishing Simulation & Awareness

Reporting & Dashboard Management

Experience working on Federally funded projects and with Federal customers.

jobs.description:
About FX Digital

FX Digital is a specialist Connected TV agency, providing a wide range of services, including Product Strategy, Design, Engineering, and Test Automation. We partner with global streaming brands such as Discovery+, BritBox, ATP Media, ITV, and Dyn.

Role Summary

Owns end-to-end delivery on complex or multi-workstream projects: planning, RAID, budgets, forecasting, margin and change control, anticipating risk before it's raised. Leads cross-functional project teams, including TAs, Product Managers, Designers, Engineers and QAs. A trusted senior contact who builds strong client relationships, leads difficult conversations unsupported and keeps senior stakeholders informed proactively.

Brings solutions rather than problems, introduces new practices and tools, and formally mentors and/or manages junior colleagues, building a psychologically safe, accountable team environment on their projects.

What You'll Do

Delivery Performance

Planning - build integrated plans across workstreams, manage the cross-workstream critical path, and model scenarios to support decisions.
Risk & RAID - anticipate systemic risk across workstreams and drive mitigation across teams; keep RAID decision-ready, so it's used as the source of truth in client and leadership reviews.
Change control - run change control across your projects, taking every CR through approval.
Agile & continuous delivery - tailor the agile approach across workstreams; use delivery metrics to forecast and spot risk early.
Releases - work with Engineering to move projects towards continuous delivery (feature flags, automated release gates, frequent small releases), balanced against client approval and CTV platform certification.
Product Owner role - act as Product Owner on smaller, less complex projects with no dedicated Product Manager, owning the backlog, prioritisation and acceptance criteria; judge when a dedicated Product Manager is needed instead.
Delivery KPIs - keep schedule and cost variance, RAG-red weeks and project lifecycle sign-offs on track against department targets across complex portfolios.

Financial Performance

Budgets, forecasting & margin - own budgets, forecasting and margin across larger or concurrent projects, protecting margin proactively.
Cadence - monitor weekly, re-forecast at least fortnightly, and flag any margin variance across all your projects.
CR estimates - estimate change requests with the team before any commitment is made to the client.
Time & overtime - track time accurately and follow the overtime request process where applicable.
Forecast accuracy - keep forecast accuracy at or above the department KPIs.

Client Experience

Client relationship management - act as the trusted senior contact for client stakeholders, building trust-based relationships and leading difficult conversations and negotiations unsupported.
Status communication - keep client and internal senior stakeholders informed with proactive, consistent status updates across workstreams.
Issue & defect communication - communicate issues, defects and bugs proactively, factually and promptly, including unwelcome news to senior stakeholders, always with options.
Technical translation - frame technical trade-offs for senior or executive stakeholders, and challenge technical recommendations that don't serve the client outcome.
Client feedback - seek regular client feedback across your projects and act on it, keeping client satisfaction at or above the department target and adopting a ‘yes, but' approach where required.

Operational Excellence

Tools & reporting - champion best practice across the team's tools.
Innovation & continuous improvement - introduce new practices and tools on your projects, measure the results and share them; drive process improvement beyond your own projects.
AI & new tools - lead adoption of FX-approved AI and automation tools across your workstreams, within FX tooling and client data policies.

Leadership & Collaboration

Team leadership & mentoring - formally mentor and/or manage junior colleagues and set the team culture on your projects, building a psychologically safe, accountable environment.
Stakeholder management - resolve competing priorities between senior client and internal stakeholders without escalation (e.g. launch date vs stability, extra scope vs budget).
Account growth - actively shape and pitch expansion opportunities, starting from what the client is trying to achieve.
Impact assessments - own impact assessments for new or expanded scope, including delivery approach, risk and resourcing, and present them to the Commercial Team and client where applicable.

What You Bring

Judgement under pressure - consistently acts as a Project Leader, not a coordinator: anticipates problems before they land, brings solutions and a recommendation, makes the call on difficult trade-offs, and stays composed under pressure.
Ownership - anticipates slippage; holds team and self to the same standard.
Strategic thinking - shapes delivery approach and planning decisions; anticipates future account needs.
Communication - reads senior and executive audiences and adapts the message in the moment.
Candour - delivers unwelcome news to senior stakeholders, with options.
Innovation mindset - actively looks for new practices and technology that improve delivery, and tests them rather than waiting for others to.
Learning - shares what they learn across the department.
Collaboration - creates an environment where mistakes are raised without blame.
Influence - influences without authority across disciplines and senior stakeholders.

Experience

5-8 years leading complex or concurrent delivery, with demonstrated mentoring and/or management of other PMs, or equivalent demonstrated capability.

Desirable

Experience in a digital agency, ideally delivering apps or streaming products for multiple clients.
Exposure to OTT/CTV, streaming, or broader digital product delivery.
Experience building or improving a delivery process or templates that the department went on to adopt.
Experience leading adoption of AI or new tooling within a delivery team.

Why work at FX?

To recognise everyone's incredible contribution to the success of the business, we offer an annual profit share
Personal development is hugely important, so we invest time for you to up-skill, learn and grow
Pension contributions with Scottish Widows
Vitality health insurance*
Cycle-to-work scheme*
35 days of annual leave, including bank holidays and Christmas office shutdown
Early finish Fridays in the summer
Flexible working - with the option to work 2 days a week from home
We appreciate that the world has changed and so we also offer a flexi start time between 9am and 10am
To ensure that our remote workers don't miss out on the office experience, we have invested in technology that allows us to run company events in a hybrid way
Every month you have the option of a one-on-one Sanctus mental health coaching session, a great opportunity to get quality mental health support at work
Take part in regular company-wide and team-specific socials (both in-person and remote)
We take great pride in our culture of acceptance, diversity and inclusion
Complete regular surveys to provide anonymous feedback on the business, leadership team and your role to ensure that we are doing everything we can to keep improving and making FX a great place to work
Join us at our monthly Show and Tell, where team members update us on what they've been working on
Get nominated for the monthly FX Factor by your peers and get recognised for your contribution to the business
We are invested in your growth and so we run regular appraisals, to ensure you are receiving constant feedback and working towards goals for growth
We support our team to get involved in conferences, events and trade shows at home and abroad
Work with epic and prestigious global brands in the media, sport and entertainment space, from Discovery to BBC and ATP Media

If you're passionate about this role and believe you can add value, we encourage you to apply, even if your background doesn't match the job description exactly.

This is a full-time role based out of our office in Old Street, London. We can only consider applicants who are able to work 3 days per week from the office.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Business Analyst to support digital transformation initiatives within the pharmaceutical and biopharmaceutical industries. The role focuses on improving how scientific, laboratory, and manufacturing data is collected, integrated, monitored, and analyzed in real time. You will act as a key link between business stakeholders, scientists, manufacturing specialists, and technical teams, translating complex operational workflows into clear business and technical requirements. Your work will contribute to projects involving bioprocessing, cell health monitoring, potency assays, laboratory automation, and integrated manufacturing systems. You will help optimize processes, strengthen data visibility, and support the development of innovative analytics solutions. This freelance opportunity offers exposure to international teams, advanced technologies, and impactful projects in a highly specialized industry environment.

Accountabilities

Lead requirements-gathering workshops, stakeholder interviews, discovery sessions, and business process analysis activities.
Analyze and document existing (AS-IS) and future-state (TO-BE) laboratory and manufacturing workflows.
Gather, define, and document functional, non-functional, data, integration, reporting, security, and compliance requirements.
Create business process diagrams, BPMN models, swimlane diagrams, data-flow diagrams, and requirements traceability matrices.
Translate business and scientific needs into Jira epics, features, user stories, functional specifications, and clearly defined acceptance criteria.

Support solution assessments, backlog prioritization, implementation planning, and project delivery activities.
Contribute to testing activities, including User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and ensure requirements are properly validated.

Produce key project deliverables, including process documentation, requirements specifications, integration inventories, decision logs, risk assessments, prioritized backlogs, UAT scenarios, and operational handover documentation.

Requirements

At least 5 years of professional experience as a Business Analyst, Business Systems Analyst, or Product Analyst in complex technology environments.
Strong hands-on experience in business requirements elicitation, analysis, documentation, and stakeholder management.
Demonstrated ability to analyze complex business workflows and translate business needs into actionable technical requirements.
Experience with business process modeling methodologies, including BPMN, SIPOC, swimlane diagrams, or equivalent approaches.
Ability to document system integrations, data flows, business rules, systems of record, and non-functional requirements.
Experience creating user stories, acceptance criteria, functional specifications, and requirements traceability documentation.
Strong working knowledge of Jira, Confluence, and Agile/Scrum methodologies.
Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Excellent analytical thinking, problem-solving, communication, workshop facilitation, and documentation skills.
Professional working proficiency in English.
Experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing, biotechnology, bioprocessing, laboratory automation, or scientific data management is highly desirable.
Understanding of Process Analytical Technology (PAT), real-time process monitoring, cell health analysis, and potency assays is an advantage.
Familiarity with laboratory instruments, manufacturing equipment, scientific workflows, and time-series data is beneficial.
Knowledge of regulated environments, including GxP, Computerized System Validation (CSV), audit trails, and data integrity requirements, is preferred.
Familiarity with industrial automation and integration technologies such as Ignition, OPC UA, and DeltaV is a plus.
Exposure to cloud-based data platforms and analytics technologies, including Databricks, Python, and MLOps, is advantageous.
Experience with manufacturing systems, laboratory data integration, industrial data pipelines, architecture assessments, vendor evaluations, or digital transformation projects is desirable.
Hands-on development experience with the technologies mentioned is not mandatory; the priority is the ability to understand complex scientific and technical concepts and translate them into clear requirements.

Benefits

Freelance / contract engagement within an international project environment.
Fully remote working opportunity from Europe.
Opportunity to contribute to projects within biopharmaceutical manufacturing, laboratory systems, and real-time analytics.
Exposure to advanced scientific technologies, manufacturing processes, and data-driven transformation initiatives.
Collaboration with multidisciplinary international teams, including scientists, product managers, architects, and engineering specialists.
Opportunity to influence the development of innovative solutions for laboratory digitalization and manufacturing process optimization.

jobs.description:
Cabot Corporation (NYSE: CBT) is a leading global specialty chemicals and performance materials company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, USA.

Our businesses deliver a broad range of products and solutions to customers in every corner of the globe, serving the transportation, infrastructure, environment and consumer industry sectors. We bring the power of innovative chemistry to solve customers' challenges today while preparing them to meet tomorrow’s needs. Our commitment to innovation is driven by a passion to advance our customers' businesses through our deep understanding of their applications and the global trends that impact their operations.

If you do not meet every requirement, or your experience is slightly different that what we have listed, we still encourage you to apply!

Job Requirements

Defines project(s) goals, plans, and deliverables in alignment with business objectives to ensure projects are fit for purpose (weighing business requirements, practicality, and cost to deliver).
Organizes resources, sets priorities and timeframe for deliverables.
Develops and implements a project risk management plan including risk identification and mitigation to establishes actions to minimize and mitigate risks.
Provides technical, financial, and project leadership to the team to the successful completion of all phases of capital or expense projects.
Ensures team members have necessary tools and resources in order to conduct their daily tasks.
Motivates and directs project activities of internal and external team members.
Directs and coordinates the effective and on time implementation of multiple projects through the motivation and coordination of a project team.
Leads across organizational boundaries.
Collaborates with other functions as needed for total project success.
Ensures that early phase project scopes and cost estimates are reasonable, thus avoiding delays, rework and even cancellation in the execution phases.
Develops and monitors project(s) budget and schedules, forecast completion, and identifies and resolves threats to on-time project completion.
Applies intensive and diverse knowledge of principles and practices in areas of assignment and related fields.
Shares learnings across the organization.
Oversees, monitors, expedites, and controls outside contractors (e.g., engineering, equipment, consultants, construction) assigned to work on the project(s) Ensures capital project is compliant with local and national regulations, codes, and standards.
Provides input, feedback on team members’ and provides updates to Regional Engineering Managers and ensures consistent communication in the matrix organization.

Competencies

Strong technical knowledge in engineering discipline(s) and project controls (e.g., estimating, cost control, change management, planning-scheduling, risk management, progress measurement, reporting).
Broad / practical knowledge of Project Management methodologies, contracting strategies, best practices, and tools.
Extensive project management skills with ability to lead cross-functional teams.
Has the ability to leverage resources from cross-functional sources.
Ability to lead, motivate and influence others; can build and effectively lead teams focused on agreed aligned objectives.
Proficient with contract and contractor management.
Expert knowledge and experience of the installation of manufacturing systems, processes, and equipment.
Multi-disciplinary knowledge including process engineering, process safety, civil-structural, piping, mechanical, electrical, instrumentation / analyzers, process automation, SH&E, and construction management.
Strong English language (written, verbal, and presentation skills).
English and Chinese language skills are required.
Mature, self-starter and self-motivated; can work unsupervised and initiate solutions without awaiting instruction.
Excellent management and organizational skills.
Excellent computer skills.
Ability to formulate and present ideas in a convincing and persuasive manner to all levels of the organization; provide well-developed technical advice.
Promoter of Safety, Health, and Environmental awareness leading to best-in-class SHE results.
Regular / extended travel is required to assigned project location(s) for engineering and construction within region.
Occasional travel outside of region may be required.
Strong skills in thinking strategically, innovating, planning, managing change, managing stakeholders, influencing, negotiating, persuading, collaborating, and communicating at all levels.

Education/Experience

Bachelor of Science / University degree in Engineering in related discipline (e.g., chemical, mechanical, electrical preferred) with >10 years of related experience with minimum five (5) years direct project management experience in a large capital project environment.
Advanced / graduate degree (e.g., engineering, business, engineering management) preferred.
Experience in project execution and project management with a strong background as a project engineer consisting of high value / complex projects with full accountability.
As Project Manager, managed and successfully delivered projects above 30 MM USD in chemical, petrochemical, refinering, heavy manufacturing industries.
Plant engineering and turnaround coordination experience is a plus.
Work experience from Owner’s perspective is preferred but experience in engineering companies is also valuable.
Experience with a formal Project Management phase-gate methodology required and formal PM certification preferred (e.g., Project Management Professional through PMI, company-specific equivalent).
Professional engineering license (or foreign equivalent) is strongly preferred.

At Cabot, we bring the power of innovative chemistry and a spirit of partnership with our customers to advance solutions that will enable a sustainable future. Our strength in research and development is a major reason why we have been an industry leader for more than 135 years in products such as reinforcing and specialty carbons, battery materials, aerogel, fumed metal oxides, inkjet colorants, masterbatches and conductive compounds.
